events.verdict: Sabonis (SAC) moves alongside Davis' (LAL) path and marginal body contact occurs during his upward shooting motion. Sabonis trips over his teammates foot, which causes him to fall after contesting the shot.
Fox (SAC) brings his arm forward as Reaves (LAL) rips-through and marginal body contact occurs at the start of the drive.
Monk (SAC) steps forward into Russell's (LAL) path and initiates illegal foot to foot contact that affects his SQBR during the drive.
Murray (SAC) touches the ball last before going out of bounds.
Fox (SAC) makes clean contact with the ball and cleanly dislodges it away from Davis (LAL) prior to incidental arm contact occurring.
Vincent (LAL) sprints back into Monk's (SAC) path and avoids making body contact with Monk as he gathers the ball into his upward shooting motion.
Sabonis (SAC) legally contests Davis' (LAL) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Sabonis (SAC) establishes a screening position in Vincent's (LAL) path and marginal contact occurs to his side as he moves over the pick.
Monk (SAC) commits a take foul on Davis (LAL).
Monk (SAC) grasps and then quickly releases James' (LAL) jersey and marginal contact occurs as the screen is set.

James (LAL) illegally touches the ball after it hits the backboard and has a chance to score. Replay review of the goaltend called on James (LAL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful.
Vincent (LAL) and Monk (SAC) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and marginal contact occurs.
